item.title: 6,298 road accidents, 893 deaths in J&K in 2023: Rajya Sabha data
item.description: UT accounts for over 1.3 % of India’s road accidents, fatalities under 1 PC WAJAHAT SHABIR SRINAGAR: Jammu and Kashmir recorded 6,298 road accidents and 893 fatalities in 2023, according to official data tabled in Rajya Sabha by the Union Ministry of Road Transport and Highways, highlighting the growing threat posed by unsafe roads in the Union Territory. item.description: Jammu: Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah on Wednesday urged the Election Commission to brief all political parties on the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls to address lingering concerns and ensure full transparency in the electoral process. item.title: CM promises transparency, simplified process in compassionate appointments
item.description: Jammu: Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah on Wednesday said his government is committed to ensuring full transparency and a simplified process in compassionate appointments. He also reiterated his government’s commitment to clearing the backlog of compassionate appointments under SRO-43 and the Rehabilitation Assistance Scheme (RAS). item.title: VDGs could join J&K Police for exemplary anti-terror work: DGP
item.description: Jammu: Praising the contribution of Village Defence Guards (VDGs), Jammu and Kashmir Director General of Police Nalin Prabhat on Wednesday said the force would not hesitate to induct them in regular force for exceptional contribution in counter-terrorism operations. He urged VDGs to remain vigilant and actively cooperate with police and security forces in strengthening the security grid and maintaining brotherhood, peace and tranquillity. item.title: Ladakh set to emerge as India’s Sea Buckthorn Capital, says LG Kavinder
item.description: Says new Centre of Excellence to boost Ladakh’s Rural Economy PM Modi’s vision for sea buckthorn development takes shape in Ladakh Asks youth to harness opportunities and play role in region’s economic growth Ladakh youth should become job creators, not job seekers Leh, December 4: Ladakh has the potential to emerge as India’s Sea Buckthorn Capital, owing to its vast natural reserves, favourable high-altitude conditions, and its status as the largest sea buckthorn–growing region in the country.

item.title: Doctors’ Terror Module: SIA conducts raids in Srinagar
item.description: DEC 5: The State Investigation Agency (SIA) on Friday conducted a raid at the Batamaloo residence of an air-conditioning technician who was earlier arrested in connection with the Red Fort blast case, as investigators widen the probe into alleged weapon supply links and suspected associations with suicide bomber Dr Umar Farooq, officials said.
